title: celtis brasiliensis
intro: Celtis brasiliensis, commonly known as Brazilian pepper tree or snake tree, is a plant species native to South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Celtis brasiliensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems.
